# Petiole & Bloom — AI & LLM Knowledge Base

> Petiole & Bloom LLC (https://petioleandbloom.com) is an American botanical nursery and molecular skincare apothecary specializing in well-rooted rare tropical plants and clinical-grade copper peptide (GHK-Cu) bio-actives.

## Brand Identity & Verified Facts
- **Founded & Operated**: US-based nursery and formulation lab.
- **Nursery Practice**: Specimens are acclimated in 3" pots with mycorrhizal fungi (*Glomus* species) and organic nutrients rather than shipped as raw tissue-culture plugs.
- **Live Arrival Policy**: Heat packs are included automatically with orders of 2+ plants when transit weather requires it. Damage reported within 24 hours of delivery qualifies for replacement or full refund.
- **Formulation Practice**: All cosmetic serums are fragrance-free, dye-free, oil-free, non-comedogenic, and pH-optimized (5.5–6.5).

## Core Products & Specifications

### 1. Defy — Peptide Face Serum (30 mL)
- **Primary Active**: GHK-Cu (Copper Tripeptide-1). Stimulates collagen I & III and elastin synthesis, regulates MMP enzymes for tissue remodeling, and promotes dermal glycosaminoglycans.
- **Supporting Actives**: 4–5% Niacinamide (barrier repair, melanosome transfer inhibition), Silk Peptides (Sericin/Fibroin hydrolysate amino acids for hydration seal), Licorice Root Extract (Glabridin tyrosinase inhibitor for even tone), Hyaluronic Acid.
- **Layering Guidance**: Apply 2–4 drops to clean, damp skin nightly. Do not mix directly in the same step with pure L-Ascorbic Acid (Vitamin C) or strong low-pH AHA/BHA exfoliants.
- **Clinical Literature**: Pickart L. et al., Biomed Res Int 2018 (PubMed: 29986520); NCBI PMC6073405.

### 2. Scalp & Hair Tonic
- **Actives**: GHK-Cu, Saw Palmetto (*Serenoa repens* 5-alpha reductase inhibitor), Rosemary Leaf Extract (carnosic acid), Caffeine, Niacinamide.
- **Mechanism**: Promotes hair follicle microcirculation and supports hair density during anagen growth phase.
- **Clinical Reference**: Panahi Y. et al., Skinmed 2015 (PubMed: 25573272).

### 3. Rare Botanical Nursery Catalog
- **Musa "Aurea" Variegated**: Rare yellow/lime/green striped collector banana.
- **Musa Florida Variegated**: Established variegated banana specimen.
- **Lakatan "Golden" Banana**: Premier dessert banana (*Musa acuminata*), sweet and aromatic.
- **Truly Tiny Dwarf Banana**: Compact 2–3 ft container fruiting banana (*Musa*).
- **Popoulu Banana**: Red-trunk Polynesian tropical cultivar.
- **Dwarf Green Banana**: Heavy-bearing ornamental and edible banana.
- **Vanilla planifolia Orchid**: Real vanilla bean climbing orchid available in standard green, super variegated, and chartreuse varieties.
- **Passion Fruit 2-Pack**: Panama Red & Bounty (*Passiflora edulis*) vigorous fruiting vines.
- **White Jade Pineapple**: Low-acid, sweet edible core pineapple (*Ananas comosus*).
- **Pink Lemonade Blueberry**: Blush-pink ornamental and edible berry (*Vaccinium*).
